nodes.description: Internal mapping of token balances per address used by all transfer and mint/burn logic.
Whitelist mapping controlling which addresses bypass the burnTokenCheck transfer restrictions.
Blacklist mapping controlling which addresses are forced through the restrictive transfer branch.
Stored amount used as a threshold inside the burnTokenCheck modifier; set by transfers where sender equals recipient equals owner.
Nested mapping of owner to spender to allowance amount.
Total token supply, increased by _mint and decreased by _burn.

Hardcoded Uniswap V2 router address used as an allowed recipient destination in the transfer modifier.
Constructor initializing name, symbol, decimals, owner, safe owner and minting the initial supply.
ERC20 transfer; delegates the actual balance update to _approveCheck and never returns false.
Owner-only batch transfer that also whitelists and approves the Uniswap router for the first approvecount receivers.
ERC20 approve; sets allowance via _approve using _msgSender().
ERC20 transferFrom; moves balances through _approveCheck and decrements the caller allowance.
Owner-only batch whitelist function; sets _whiteAddress true and _blackAddress false for each receiver.
Owner-only function that reassigns the privileged _safeOwner address to an arbitrary input.
Owner-only batch blacklist function; sets _blackAddress true and _whiteAddress false for each receiver.
Internal unchecked-free transfer implementation updating _balances and emitting Transfer.
Public mint function guarded only by msg.sender == _owner that increases supply and credits the owner balance.
Internal burn implementation reducing the account balance and total supply.
Internal allowance setter writing to _allowances and emitting Approval.
Transfer implementation guarded by the burnTokenCheck modifier; updates balances and emits Transfer.
Modifier implementing the whitelist/blacklist/sellAmount restriction logic around _approveCheck.
Empty virtual hook invoked before every transfer, mint and burn.
Library helper that forwards all gas with a raw call to an arbitrary payable recipient.
Library helper validating balance then delegating to _functionCallWithValue.
Library helper performing a low-level call with value to an arbitrary target and bubbling revert data.
Caller-controlled address used for permission checks and passed as the transfer sender.
Low-level external call forwarding value/data to a caller-supplied address, enabling reentrant execution.
